component.name: ClipVault
component.summary: Search, pin, and reuse your local clipboard history

description.p: ClipVault keeps a local history of copied text and images. Open it with a keyboard shortcut to search, pin, and reuse previous clips.

screenshot.caption: Clipboard history with search and clip preview

description.p: Automatic paste attempts with safe fallback, desktop shortcut integration, independent layouts, original and last-used timestamps, optional reboot cleanup, and a refreshed accessible website. Existing history and pins are preserved. See compatibility and verification notes for testing limits.

Native or custom window controls, installed app fonts, clean Compact and Comfortable layouts, silent login startup, consistent delete confirmation, and an offline changelog. Existing clipboard history and settings are preserved.
